description: Design 0013's SQLite stores (PRF-5g-1): each database as the stores reference's own module creates it through better-sqlite3 (getDb on a new file, then closeDb), read back: sqlite_master's rows in rowid order (type, name, tbl_name, rootpage, sql), user_version and journal_mode. The core creates each with the same DDL and must read back the same rows. `payments` (PRF-5g-2, sqlite-payments.js): payment-history.js's operations on one database and its legacy x402-receipts.json imports, each step's result (its answer, or the error it threw) and the table after it where it changed (each column as [typeof, value], an INTEGER as its decimal text).

sqlite_master.name: payments
sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TABLE payments (
        id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        kind          TEXT    NOT NULL,
        chain_id      INTEGER NOT NULL,
        tx_hash       TEXT,
        from_address  TEXT,
        to_address    TEXT,
        asset         TEXT,
        amount        TEXT    NOT NULL,
        origin        TEXT,
        url           TEXT,
        status        TEXT    NOT NULL,
        created_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
        confirmed_at  INTEGER,
        gas_used      TEXT,
        gas_price     TEXT,
        metadata      TEXT
      )

sqlite_master.name: idx_payments_created
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_payments_created ON payments(created_at DESC)

sqlite_master.name: publishes
sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TABLE publishes (
        id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        type          TEXT NOT NULL,
        name          TEXT,
        status        TEXT NOT NULL,
        reference     TEXT,
        bzz_url       TEXT,
        tag_uid       INTEGER,
        batch_id      TEXT,
        origin        TEXT,
        bytes_size    INTEGER,
        started_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
        completed_at  INTEGER,
        error_message TEXT
      )

sqlite_master.name: idx_publishes_started
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_publishes_started   ON publishes(started_at DESC)
